newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan on Michelin estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - JP Morgan on Michelin estimates.

text.p: JP Morgan on Friday made changes to its sales and earnings per share estimates for French tyremaker Michelin, which reported stronger than expected first-half sales on Wednesday, the investment bank said on Friday.
EPS estimates for 1997, excluding exceptional items and applying a constant 33 percent tax rate, were raised to 30.8 francs from 30.6 francs, JP Morgan said.
For 1998, EPS estimates were lifted to 33.9 france from 33.4, it said.

Sales forecasts for 1997 were raised to 79.1 billion francs from 77.2 billion, JP Morgan said, after Michelin reported first-half consolidated sales of 38.4 billion francs, up from 34.9 billion a year ago.
Michelin is expected to report first-half results on September 16, JP Morgan said in a report, adding it had a "buy" rating on the stock.
